dataset.dataset: SQuAD2.0 balanced answerability and short/long complete-passage subset
dataset.citation: Rajpurkar, Jia, Liang (2018). Know What You Don't Know: Unanswerable Questions for SQuAD. arXiv:1806.03822.
dataset.policy: All four answerability/length strata equally represented; one question per distinct context across each split. Complete original passages only; no cropping, answer removal, distractor insertion or truncation. Native impossible questions have no gold answers; plausible_answers are never targets. All official-train articles unseen in both prior train and validation form the new validation pool. New test excludes prior test IDs and contexts; its source articles were evaluated previously. Current train/validation/test articles are disjoint. Gold answers filter eligibility and scoring but never construct model input.
dataset.sampling: Rarest distinct-context stratum first, then seeded shuffled questions with round-robin shuffled articles; reserve selected contexts globally before the next stratum.
limitations: Balanced filtered subset, not the full SQuAD2 distribution or hidden official test.
Long means 193-512 model tokens under the recorded configuration, not arbitrary multi-page documents.
New test records differ from the previous test, but the Wikipedia articles and some question forms are related.
Historical public material may have appeared in base-model pretraining; exact checks cannot rule out near duplicates or related facts.

selection.criterion: Among validation-gate-passing checkpoints, maximize harmonic mean of answerable exact match and explicit missing-answer recall, then strict F1, strict EM, then lower validation loss; initial adapter is fallback.

limitations: Balanced filtered SQuAD2 subset, not official benchmark scores or production prevalence.
Long means 193–512 subword tokens in a complete original passage, not a multipage document or OCR.
Prior test IDs and passages are excluded, but official-development article topics were evaluated historically.
Historical SQuAD/Wikipedia may have appeared in base-model pretraining; no claim of unseen factual knowledge.
Validation gate allows up to 0.05 absolute loss of answerable EM and F1; held-out test is descriptive and never selects settings.
Explicit NOT_FOUND is required for strict missing-answer credit; separately reported official normalized scores may credit malformed empty outputs.
Raw passages/questions/references/generated text and weights remain in local ignored artifacts.

Elapsed time excludes dataset preparation, Python imports/startup and final metrics serialization. It includes warmstart loading, baseline evaluation, training, generated validation, saving and selected test evaluation.
Output lengths and workload differ from previous experiments; no new speedup claim is made.
